name: Shakti lucid-dream series: sessions 1-5, temporal
origin: Todd Murphy, 8 Coil Shakti (pattern drawn from user reports)
summary: Sessions 1 to 5 of Murphy's lucid-dreaming series: the amygdala and hippocampal signals in sequence over both temporal lobes. Murphy says such temporal sessions are 'probably ... a prerequisite' for the frontal session 6, and bases the series on 'a few Shakti reports' with no laboratory study.
setting: Dark, quiet room, eyes closed; relax without meditating or falling asleep. The vendor says most sessions behind its dream reports 'were done shortly before sleep'.
schedule: Five sessions, then session 6 (murphy-shakti-lucid-dream-series-frontal). The vendor gives only this order: one session a week is this project's choice within the vendor's general rules. Never on consecutive days; after the series take the vendor's 21-day break.
notes: The vendor gives the order only: 'five Shakti sessions over the temporal lobes, with the sixth (and last) in the series being the frontal lobe session' (lucid_dream.htm). Its 8-coil version of this signal asks for four coils over each ear and exists only with fast or slow alternation between its two stereo channels, fast being a switch every half second (8_coil_amy_hip_in_sequence_consent.htm). This program plays 30 min on all 8 coils, four per side (front FT7/FT8, top C5/C6, back TP7/TP8, bottom T9/T10), all together, without alternation. The 30 min and the site names are this project's choices. One cycle lasts 9.4 s: amygdala 0.69 s, silence 4 s, hippocampus 0.74 s, silence 4 s. The amygdala signal is the project's rising sweep (6 to 30 Hz) with the published point duration and length (230 points of 3 ms); the point values were never published as numbers (the lab prints the shape only as a small figure). The hippocampal stand-in is the primed burst: one pulse, then four pulses 170 ms later, three times in 0.74 s (after Tsang 2004 p.5 [1017]). Both are rebuilt from descriptions: the vendor's files are not published. Field strength: the vendor gives 10 to 20 mG without saying where it is measured (mono_proposal.htm, 'Formal Discussion'). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. Support: 'There have been no laboratory studies about it, but there have been a few Shakti reports' (dreaming.htm, LUCID DREAMING). Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Another dream session: murphy-shakti-lucid-dream-series-chirp-hipp. Headache or pressure with hippocampal signals (vendor: about 2%): lower the intensity by one third. Not for people with epilepsy or a seizure history; stop at once on fear or any distress.
